regressions.title: Action contract/quarantine/turn liveness
regressions.permanent_invariant: One canonical ActionPlan codec/ActionKey; malformed/rejected same-frame actions cannot loop indefinitely.

regressions.title: Delayed confirmation and scoped reconciliation
regressions.permanent_invariant: Possible send plus delayed confirmation must not cause duplicate input or unjustified global disarm.

regressions.title: Fight geometry authority and pre-DOWN revalidation
regressions.permanent_invariant: Fight-scoped server legality and static geometry are distinct; revalidate identity/state immediately before DOWN.

regressions.title: Turn/resource causal freshness
regressions.permanent_invariant: Freshness follows semantic causal windows; delayed/duplicate turn events cannot reopen old authority.

regressions.title: Process/control ownership generation
regressions.permanent_invariant: PID/HWND identity requires generation proof; stale or foreign ownership fails closed.

regressions.title: Opaque protocol drift after successful action
regressions.permanent_invariant: Unknown traffic is capability-scoped and evidence-classified; exact opaque fingerprints never generalize to changed variants.
